messages:
samir: Heads up — audit triggered: tenant 'acme-corp' decrypted a blob using key alias 'redwood/tenant-global' at 15:07 UTC. Looks like alias -> key resolution ignored tenant boundaries. cc @lizzie @danielle
lizzie: link to alert: https://internal/alerts/45321 — confirming the decrypt log shows `key_alias=redwood/tenant-global` and `principal=svcacc-deploy`
samir: paste from audit: 
```
2026-03-18T15:07:12Z INFO kms.decrypt tenant=acme-corp key_alias=redwood/tenant-global key_id=projects/infra/kms/keys/tenant-global decrypt_ok=true principal=svcacc-deploy
```
danielle: svcacc-deploy should not be able to decrypt tenant-owned keys. Did the RBAC refactor go out yesterday? @ops-bot rolled something right?
ops-bot: Deploy 2026-03-18T14:45:00 - rolerefactor-serviceaccount-binding v2 deployed to prod (canary 14:39) :rocket:
lizzie: yes, the refactor changed how we resolve key aliases: we introduced an org-level fallback when tenant-scoped alias lookup fails. that fallback should have been gated to allowlist, but the gate was inverted. suspect that's causing this.
samir: repro steps I ran locally:
1) assume-role tenant=acme-corp using svcacc-deploy creds
2) POST to /decrypt with `keyAlias=redwood/tenant-global`
3) decrypt returns 200 + plaintext
Command: 
```
curl -X POST https://kms.internal/decrypt -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"keyAlias":"redwood/tenant-global","cipher":"..."}'
```
danielle: this is P0 — cross-tenant decrypt = data exposure. Can we flip a rollback?
lizzie: preparing hotfix. quick mitigation: add an explicit policy deny for alias resolution fallback so tenant alias resolution does not fall through to org keys. patching now.
samir: audit also shows subsequent reads from workspace metadata bucket by acme-corp within 3 mins. potential exfil path if they had access to decrypted secrets.
danielle: notifying legal and CS for customer impact assessment. pinging @maria to create incident channel and contact lists.
maria: opened #inc-2901, added legal and cs oncall. collecting affected tenants list now.
lizzie: PR opened: `fix(kms): restore tenant-scoped alias lookup + explicit deny fallback` — includes unit test for alias resolution and an integration test run against staging. linking PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/kms/pulls/817
ops-bot: Rollback window scheduled at 15:40 UTC if eng-oncall approves.
samir: detection mitigation: adding alert rule to fire when `decrypt_ok=true` and `principal.tenant != key.owner_tenant`. deploying alert in 5m.
lizzie: pushed hotfix to prod at 15:32 UTC, rolling restart of kms-resolver. monitoring logs.
danielle: any signs of successful exfil?
samir: so far only the single decrypt + metadata reads. nothing else in network logs. still scanning S3 access logs.
maria: legal recommends holding release notes until we confirm scope. initiating customer notification draft for impacted orgs.
lizzie: tests pass and alias resolution reverted to tenant-priority. will leave explicit deny in place until RBAC redo validated. :thumbsup:
danielle: good work. keep updating this thread — if more tenants pop up we'll escalate to SEC ops.
samir: will follow up with a short postmortem and runbook edits (how to revoke keys, rotate aliases, and temporary deny rules). thanks all.
